usage: Use 公司 to mean a business, firm, or company. It is a very common everyday noun in Hong Kong Cantonese.
It often appears in compound words and job-related phrases, such as 公司名, 公司職員, or 去公司.
For a specific company name, you can put the name before 公司, like X公司. This is normal in both spoken and written Cantonese.
In conversation, 公司 is neutral and widely used in work, finance, and daily life. It can refer to both local and foreign companies.
